title: 5th Internal Assessment — Schedule Released
summary: The 5th Internal Assessment schedule is released. Students are advised to verify their session timings on the notice board and clear lab record submissions before the assessment begins.

title: 1st Internal Examination — Session 2026 Schedule
summary:
The 1st Internal Examination for all departments and semesters will run as per the schedule displayed on departmental boards. Students must carry valid institute identity cards to every paper.

Schedule queries: departmental offices / exam cell.

title: Odd Semester Fee Payment Window
summary:
Fee payment for the running odd semester is open at the accounts counter during office hours. Semester fees are payable per the instalment schedule issued with the admission form.

Carry your fee book / previous receipt to the counter.

title: Seminar: Green & Clean Energy
summary:
A special seminar on green and clean energy will be conducted on campus — renewable technology trends, solar power practice and career pathways for diploma engineers.

Open to all branches. Seats are limited; register with your department office.

title: NHIT Private ITI — Trade Admissions Open
summary: Admissions are open at NHIT Private ITI for the Electrician and Fitter trades. Eligibility and trade norms per NCVT / State Council guidelines — confirm details at the admission desk, Phase-II, City Center, Durgapur.

title: Farewell Ceremony — Batch 2021–2024
summary:
The institute bids farewell to the 2021–2024 diploma batch. Ceremony on campus grounds — departments will host their batches after the common programme.

Date: June 10, 2024.
